ISO C forbids all of it (6.5.3.4p1 + 6.2.5p19 + 6.5.6p2), so the `DSS = (gcc union clang union MSVC) union ISO C` bar is what decides, and a unanimous ACCEPTANCE settles it. exitCode 42 = every arm correct; ANY other exit is the failing arm's own id (1..15), so a diagnosis needs no bisection.
